scope: Reviewed duplicates, reproducible cache, and finally rejected raster originals only.

policy.historicalPathResolution: For duplicate entries read replacementPath and verify the same sha256. Rejected originals are retired, not present; their source URL, decision, digest, compact features and audit JPEG remain. Derived cache is retired, not a retained source original.
policy.futureAcquisition: Check retired source hashes/IDs and final exclusion reasons before recollecting. Reconsideration requires the public original plus fresh per-work license and duplicate checks. Compact fingerprints only screen candidates; they are not proof of perceptual uniqueness.

featureMethod.alphaPolicy: Convert palette/RGBA PNG to RGBA, then composite on opaque black for visible-shape D4 features; original SHA256 is always for unchanged input bytes. This is a screening fingerprint, not a restoration of original pixels.
